routes.result: P110 receipt and authoritative owner readback for admitted evidence/source/candidate commands; explicit error before owner write for dependency-held downstream commands

reads.posture: NO_EFFECT canonical read, available only when the A3 migration exists; no deployment or managed migration is claimed

admitted_local_behavior: EvidenceArtifact/v1 fixture metadata persistence with quarantine/review status derived by the server

ProductSource/v1 immutable observation persistence for URL, PDF, CSV/XLSX, manual, Shopify and Room Planner artifact inputs without fetching or storage effects; evidence scope/status/digest are inherited and cannot be promoted
ProductCandidate/v1 immutable persistence with disclosed finite six-component score inputs and weights, exact source lineage and duplicate review posture
claimed vendor IDs require same-tenant canonical Account readback and remain REVIEW_REQUIRED because Account has no supplier eligibility fact
every successful owner write is atomic with one P110 receipt, event and NO_EFFECT outbox row plus fresh-instance readback and TimelineEvent/v1
single-object and Project-graph readback reconstruct exact relational evidence/source lineage, status and nullable Project scope; corrupted rows fail closed

dependency_held_behavior.guarantee: application and database both reject before canonical owner write
opaque proposal IDs never produce a PO
provider acknowledgement cannot manufacture source finality

consumer_rules: Do not implement local canonical Product Source, Candidate, RFQ, Quote, Bid, Selection or PO writers.
Treat blockedDependencies and command failure codes as product-visible review blockers, not as completed procurement state.
Do not display a recommendation as a human selection or provider acknowledgement as source-confirmed completion.
Treat evidenceArtifacts, productSources and productCandidates as project-scoped wrappers and validate their exact evidence→source→candidate lineage.
Validate A1 resource producer, A2 schedule producer, A3 procurement producer and runtime release SHA independently.
No client may enable RFQ send, PO release, product-page fetching, email/provider ingestion or Portal mutation from this G0 handoff.
The authenticated GET read is not controlled by the mutation feature flags; consumers must still wait for managed migration and controller admission.
